name: Gästehaus Lärchenheim
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in the mountain village of Gerlos, Gaestehaus Laerchenheim welcomes holidaymakers with genuine warmth and comfort. Tidy rooms provide a restful retreat after active mountain days.

Access to the vast Zillertal Arena ski area and diverse alpine trails are close at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Laerchenheim in Gerlos provides cosy accommodations in the popular Zillertal Arena.
